corrections.reason: The printed glyph in the image has the bottom-right stroke of 2nd-order ሁ (የሁነው), the standard archaic Andemta spelling.
Both visually on the page (6th-order እ with the top zig-zag) and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez (እደዊሁ, 'his hands', cf. L16 እደውየ), the word begins with እ, not አ.
